title: Read but never assigned (lint rule)
summary: Project-wide lint rule: a field or global that is read but that nothing in the project assigns or creates
intro: Read this to see what read-never-assigned reports and what it treats as an assignment. It runs in lint-all and lint-project over a project index; hard-cast writes, var / out arguments, property write accessors, DFM-streamed fields, absolute, initialisers and initialization sections all count.
